caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with three drawers, each drawer having two round knobs. The dresser has a rectangular shape with slightly curved legs and a visible wood grain texture rendered in brown tones. On top of the dresser sits a marble-like flat surface in shades of gray and white. Above the marble surface is an attached vanity mirror flanked by two vertical wooden cabinets, each with a panel and decorative top molding. The central mirror is tall and rectangular with an arched, scalloped top and is bordered by a wooden frame. The background of the drawing is plain and light, with no other objects present.
title: Bride's Bureau
